justification: Reads the signed-in account's setup state and number aliases. Sends nothing, changes nothing, stays inside BreakPass.
Reads the saved Inform, Acknowledge and Escalate workflows. No side effects.
Reads delivery and acknowledgement history of alerts this client started. No side effects.
Sends one WhatsApp message to the owner's verified number: it contacts a real person outside BreakPass and spends balance. It deletes or overwrites nothing.
Sends one SMS to a verified number (outside world, spends balance). Nothing is deleted or overwritten.
Places one phone call that reads the message aloud (outside world, spends balance). Nothing is deleted or overwritten.
Starts a server-side workflow that messages and may call the owner until acknowledged (outside world, spends balance). Idempotent with an idempotency_key; nothing is deleted.
Stops the unsent steps of an alert, which cannot be undone (hence destructive), and may affect a call already ringing (open world). Safe to call twice.
